title: The Old Photo Project
segments: Maria watched Leo in his online English class. He was very quiet, barely speaking. "Leo," she said later, "I've noticed you don't talk much in class. How about we start a fun project together? We could restore old family photos. It might help you practice English and we can learn about our family history."

After that, Maria and Leo sat in their cozy living room. Maria brought out an old shoebox full of pictures. "Let's pick one to start," she smiled. Leo chose a faded photo of an old house. "Okay, Leo," Maria said gently, "Can you describe what you see in English? What objects are there?

Then, Maria pointed to the faded photo of the old house. "Look, Leo. This is a house," she said slowly. "It has a roof, windows, and a door." Leo repeated, "House... roof... window." Maria smiled. "Yes! And it's an old house, maybe with a garden." Leo pointed, "Tree?" Maria nodded, "Exactly! You're doing great. It's fun, right?"

Then, Maria smiled at Leo. "You're learning many new words!" She pointed to another picture in the shoebox. It was very old and torn. "Look, Leo! This is a photo of Grandma and Grandpa when they were young." Leo looked closely. "Grandma... Grandpa?" he asked. Maria nodded. "Yes! They look so happy in this old picture.

Because of this, Leo wanted to fix the torn photo of Grandma and Grandpa. Maria showed him how to carefully clean and piece together the old picture. She taught him words like 'restore,' 'glue,' and 'smooth.' Leo worked slowly, concentrating hard. After some time, the photo looked much better! He felt very proud of his work.

After that, Leo could not wait to show his grandparents the restored photo. On Sunday, he proudly presented it. "Grandma, Grandpa," he began, "this is you when you were young!" He explained in English how he cleaned and glued it. His grandparents smiled. Leo felt a warm glow. He had spoken clearly and confidently.
endWrap: Leo's confidence grew, and his English improved. The old photo project helped him connect with his family and find his voice. What a wonderful journey!
